turns.question: I'd love to hear about your coffee habits — think back to the last time you made a change to how you typically get your coffee, whether that was switching to a different brand, trying a new way to make it, or even just grabbing it from somewhere different than usual. What was going on that made you decide to do something different?
turns.response: Honestly, I switched to cold brew a few months back. I was just getting tired of the same routine every morning — make hot coffee, drink it too fast while it's still scalding, then I'm done. Cold brew just seemed like it would last longer, you know? I could sip it throughout the morning instead of chugging it all at once. Plus I read somewhere it's easier on your stomach or whatever.

turns.question: When you switched to cold brew, did that change how you fit coffee into the rest of your morning?
turns.response: Honestly yeah, it did a bit. Cold brew takes like two seconds to pour so I'm not standing around waiting for it to brew anymore. I guess that freed up time but I'm not doing anything crazy with it, just kind of... scrolling or getting dressed while I drink it instead of hovering over the machine.
